title: The benchmark pool's gap rows count a _gaps.md entry closed by a Closed, Partly resolved, Mostly resolved or Narrowed line as open and expect the web route
goal: bench_pool.gap_section draws its open gap entries with kbfacts.OPEN_GAP (the router's reader), so no pool gap row names an entry the router no longer answers 'the kb lacks it' for; the repro and python3 _tools/tests.py -k pack_routes_kind pass

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool,kb_hook;bad=[r['id'] for r in bench_pool.load_pool(kinds={'gap'}) if (kb_hook.answer('kb: '+r['question']) or {}).get('decision')!='block'];print('gap rows the hook does not block:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
